name: flaky-fixer
description: Diagnose and stabilize a flaky test by re-running it and isolating the non-deterministic part.
---

# Flaky Fixer

1. Re-run the failing test several times to confirm it is actually flaky.
2. Isolate the non-deterministic dependency (timing, ordering, shared state).
3. Propose a fix that removes the non-determinism.
